semantic.justification: AQF9AG ports actual Calendar field/stamp/date/week state and the original complete bidirectional UTC/field algorithms: time limits, lazy flags, validation, explicit zone/clock-field precedence, repeated/skipped-time options, strict gaps and NEXT_VALID previous-transition lookup. The known-concrete BasicTimeZone detection recognizes actual SimpleTimeZone and OlsonTimeZone; RuleBased/VTimeZone recognition awaits their actual classes. Locale/zone constructors remain abstract. Native scalar/week and UTC-field probes are retained, and45789 actual rule/transition/full-time cases match unchanged ICU78.3. CALC-310/311 preserve source nonleap-February29 NEXT_VALID behavior and release generic lookback logic; native debug assertions/ABI/undefined outputs are not certified. System/IANA construction and full LibreOffice calendar/formatter/CSV service integration remain incomplete. Known-concrete BasicTimeZone recognition now includes actual OlsonTimeZone alongside SimpleTimeZone. The native Olson witness checks actual Calendar fields-to-UTC and normalized public fields on all pinned IANA zones plus strict FIRST/LAST/NEXT_VALID gap/fold cases, including Apia day skip and Lord Howe half-hour transitions. Locale/default construction and RuleBased/VTimeZone classes remain pending. AQF9AG adds actual fZone ownership and source get/adopt/set/orphanTimeZone operations. Null adoption is ignored, const setter clones, adopt invalidates only computed fields, and orphan replaces the zone with a default clone without invalidating cached fields (CALC-319). The unchanged native Calendar and TimeZone implementations match explicit owned-zone/cache cases in the 310-case timezone-default probe. Locale/Gregorian constructors and full LibreOffice calendar/formatter/CSV service integration remain incomplete; tests bootstrap explicit zone/week state without overriding the owned getter.
